event_name: ADE Opening Concert: KYBBA & Metropole Orkest + special guests
rating_rationale: A sold-out opening concert is still useful intelligence: this is the official arts-and-culture anchor, not another room in the club pile.
lineup_djs_performers: KYBBA / Metropole Orkest / Busy Signal / Blaiz Fayah / Kalibwoy
notes: Sold out at check; use only official resale if it matters.

rating_rationale: The big-room heritage play. Not intimate, but the Oxygene/ADE anniversary logic is clean and culturally legible.
notes: Choose this if you want the anniversary monument rather than a club crawl.

event_name: Crawler + Nkisi + 2K88 & Rainy Miller & Bianca Scout
rating_rationale: Electronic music beyond the dance floor in a proper listening hall. A good first-night counterweight to the obvious club openers.
lineup_djs_performers: Crawler / Nkisi / 2K88 / Rainy Miller / Bianca Scout
notes: Best if you want a seated, sound-led start before the late week gets loud.

event_name: ANOTHER ROOM x PAX-ROMANA ADE Special
rating_rationale: A small community daytime gathering from the PAX-ROMANA crew is the right antidote to ADE scale creep.
lineup_djs_performers: Serti / Delano Legito / Anna Randt / Julie / Elisa Batti
notes: Go for a drink-and-dance reset before the heavier Thursday night choices.

rating_rationale: Alternative Asian Culture and internet-underground pop/club worlds at Parallel is exactly the kind of ADE crossover that earns a ferry.
notes: A strong Noord choice if you want something scene-specific without defaulting to techno.

rating_rationale: A daytime NDSM label session with Michael Mayer, Robag Wruhme and Extrawelt: useful if you want history without a huge-room shove.
notes: A clean Friday day option before deciding how much night is actually needed.

rating_rationale: Job Jobse at Gashouder is a very Amsterdam kind of big room. Sold out at check, but worth knowing if reliable resale appears.
notes: Do not chase bad resale. This is a signal, not a mandate.

rating_rationale: Jeff Mills, Dettmann, Helena Hauff and FJAAK make this the clean hard-techno choice if you want Westergas rather than another compromise night.
lineup_djs_performers: Jeff Mills / Marcel Dettmann / Helena Hauff / FJAAK live / Quest / Quelza / Binh / Lumiere
notes: Treat this as the Friday commitment; it is not a casual pre-party.

rating_rationale: The queer-club centre of gravity for the week: massive lineup, long format, and RAUM as the right container.
lineup_djs_performers: Alex Kassian / BASHKKA / D.Dan / Dasha Rush / Djrum / DVS1 / Octo Octa / Rodhad / Sedef Adasi / Wata Igarashi
notes: Book only if you actually want the long night and the recovery bill that comes with it.

rating_rationale: A hard daytime session at Nxt Museum makes more sense than pretending all ADE choices have to start after midnight.
lineup_djs_performers: blk. / JAZZY / Jezza & jod / Kruelty / PRADA2000 / Toxic Machinery
notes: Good if you want a contained eight-hour hit and can skip the later pile-on.

rating_rationale: A participatory light-and-sound installation gives ADE a useful non-club lane and a reason to step out of the ticket arms race.
notes: Saturday and Sunday installation access is listed as free; check exact daily entry before going.

rating_rationale: Rush Hour at Lofi is the Saturday daytime house/disco/soul choice with actual local record-shop gravity.
notes: Choose this when the day should dance without becoming a Sunday-morning problem.

event_name: PATTA x KEEP HUSH x SANKOFA ARCHIVES x MOSAIKO x STUDIO STRIP
rating_rationale: Patta, Keep Hush and Sankofa at Skatecafe is the better Saturday answer if you want Amsterdam, bass pressure and diasporic club energy in one messy room.
lineup_djs_performers: Lashanti / Jarreau Vandal / Passion DEEZ / Tida Kamara / Mondesir / more
notes: Recorded/broadcast event; be comfortable being filmed.

event_name: ZEROBPM ADE three-day ambient meditation ritual
rating_rationale: A no-talking, no-phones, no-alcohol ambient ritual is not a side quest; it is the best recovery logic ADE is likely to offer.
lineup_djs_performers: Darwin / Dasha Rush / DINA / Hitam / Isabel Soto / Richard Akingbehin / Sama / Steve Rachmad
notes: Tickets are sold by timeslot; arrive on time or do something else.

event_name: FSTM ADE TAKE OVER AT SKATECAFE
rating_rationale: Call Super, Eris Drew, Helena Hauff, mad miran and DJ Masda at Skatecafe is a Sunday closer with range instead of festival exhaustion cosplay.
lineup_djs_performers: Blasha & Allatt / Call Super / DJ Masda / Eris Drew / Helena Hauff / mad miran / Quest / Ryan Elliott
notes: A better closing day if you still have legs but do not want a mega-venue.

rating_rationale: Improvised hardware, video and lighting at Paradiso is the more interesting Sunday monument than another generic closing rave.
lineup_djs_performers: Donato Dozzy / Speedy J / The Fear Ratio / Wallis
notes: Eight hours is still eight hours. Treat it like the main plan.

event_name: Vault Sessions x KEY VINYL ADE
rating_rationale: A real final push at RADION, not a symbolic afterthought. Only choose it if Monday can absorb the damage.
lineup_djs_performers: Alarico / Fenim0re / Freddy K / Grace Dahl / Rebecca Delle Piane / Toobris / Uberkikz / Vilchezz
notes: This is the last-dance option, not a sensible travel-day choice.
